summary: A grid of headline figures and charts that stacks into one column on a phone
purposes: lay out headline figures and charts in a grid
arrange cards in columns that stack on a phone

exposes.children: The cards of the dashboard in display order: replace the map to show other numbers, or add a card with a stat for another key figure
exposes.layout.cols: The number of columns above the collapse width (the grid stacks to one column below 768 px)
